description: This file declares the JSONParser class, which implements JSON parsing logic, including tokenization, string decoding, number parsing, and error handling. It is part of the 'base' namespace and is used internally for JSON reading functionality.

classes.name: JSONParser
classes.description: Implements JSON parsing with tokenization, string handling, number parsing, and error reporting.

classes.name: JSONParser::StringBuilder
classes.description: Helper class for building JSON strings during parsing.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses input string into a Value object based on set options.

methods.name: error_code
methods.description: Returns the last parse error code.

methods.name: GetErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns a human-readable error message for the last parse error.

methods.name: error_line
methods.description: Returns the line number where the last parse error occurred.

methods.name: error_column
methods.description: Returns the column number where the last parse error occurred.
